config.time_limit_semantics: Soft limit checked after initialization and between completed targets; active target finishes; cumulative active time and overshoot recorded.
config.resume_policy: same identity; interrupted targets resume from last committed RNG/population; completed runs skipped; errors retained
config.optimization_note: Integer edge deltas and cached route loads; operator traversal, strict ties, repair RNG, full-round rollback and feasible archive preserved. Time-limited runs may finish more targets; do not pool with V2.
